timing_clarification.baseline_sta_clock: 125 MHz (8.000 ns period, clk100_raw, worst slack +0.269 ns in full002 timing.rpt)
timing_clarification.sta_policy_statement: Target budgets (300 MHz / 600 MHz) are design budgets for pure logical and architectural verification only. Without new Vivado static timing analysis (STA), no physical timing closure is claimed or implied. Clock frequency in simulation is not timing proof.

block_engine_pipeline_ctrl_v023.description: System-level pipeline drain, on-chip supply, and collection controller with parameterized PE_LATENCY, registered collection MUX, safe clear/flush, precomputed boundary masks, and double-buffer cache management.

pe_delay_stub.description: Bit-exact parameterized delay processing element and 16x16 array delay stub supporting arbitrary PE_LATENCY >= 1 with wavefront tracking.

skid_buffer.description: Zero-bubble (II=1) 2-register skid buffer breaking forward valid and backward ready combinational paths.

mathematical_drain_proof.systolic_wavefront: Injection at row r and column c with step ki arrives at corner PE(15,15) at run_cycle = 31 + 15 + 15 = 61
mathematical_drain_proof.pe_pipeline_depth: Multiplication and pipeline requires PE_LATENCY cycles
mathematical_drain_proof.accumulator_stabilization: Product updates accumulator on clock edge 61 + PE_LATENCY
mathematical_drain_proof.exact_run_limit: run_cycle == 61 + PE_LATENCY + 1 ensures all 256 PEs have finished in-place accumulation before transition to C_READ
mathematical_drain_proof.failure_of_v020: v020 hardcoded run_cycle == 65 provided 1 cycle margin at PE_LATENCY=3, exactly 0 cycles at PE_LATENCY=4, and completely failed (lost partial sums) at PE_LATENCY >= 5
